description: Weekly downbound grain barge rates on the Upper Mississippi (Cincinnati, St Louis, Cairo-Memphis and two further rate columns) from the USDA dataset on data.bts.gov. The file ends in November 2023; units are not stated in the dataset, so none are given. No draft or lock-status data. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

weeks.description: How many most recent weeks, 1 to 52 (default 4)

name: logistics_mississippi_barge_rates
title: Logistics Mississippi Barge Rates
